description: This file defines a store for managing access configurations and credentials for various AI services, including OpenAI, Azure, Google AI, and Anthropic. It includes functions for validation, fetching remote config, and migration logic.

methods.name: enabledAccessControl
methods.description: Checks if access control is enabled and fetches config if needed.

methods.name: isValidOpenAI
methods.description: Validates presence of OpenAI API key.

methods.name: isValidAzure
methods.description: Validates presence of Azure URL, API key, and version.

methods.name: isValidGoogle
methods.description: Validates presence of Google API key.

methods.name: isValidAnthropic
methods.description: Validates presence of Anthropic API key.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Determines if the current configuration is authorized based on available credentials and access control.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches configuration from server and updates store state.
